definitions.explanation: A tropical storm occurring in the western Pacific Ocean.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
{台風|たいふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Trains stopped due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of the typhoon.

notes:
{台風|たいふう} is a tropical cyclone in the western Pacific, common in Japan from August to October.

NAMING:
In Japan, typhoons are numbered sequentially each year: {台風|たいふう}{十|じゅう}{号|ごう} (Typhoon #10).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {台風|たいふう}が{来|く}る/{近|ちか}づく: a typhoon is coming/approaching
- {台風|たいふう}が{上陸|じょうりく}する: a typhoon makes landfall
- {台風|たいふう}が{過|す}ぎる: a typhoon passes
- {台風|たいふう}{情報|じょうほう}: typhoon information

RELATED:
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}: storm
- {避難|ひなん}: evacuation
- {警報|けいほう}: warning
